test_title: PYST 1: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: In a class of 37 students, there are 22 girls. The average weight of these girls is 46 kg and the average weigh of the whole class is 50 kg. What is the average weight (in kg) of the boys in that class? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Number of girls = 22

Average weight of girls = 46 kg

Total number of students = 37

Average weight of the whole class = 50 kg

**Formula Used:**

 Average Weight of Boys = (Total Weight of Boys)/(Number of Boys)

 Total Weight of Class = Average Weight of Class times Total Number of Students

 Total Weight of Girls = Average Weight of Girls times Number of Girls

**Calculation:**

Number of boys = Total number of students - Number of girls

⇒ Number of boys = 37 - 22

⇒ Number of boys = 15

⇒ Total weight of the whole class = 50 × 37 = 1850 kg

⇒ Total weight of the girls = 46 × 22 = 1012 kg

⇒ Total weight of the boys = Total weight of the class - Total weight of the girls

⇒ Total weight of the boys = 1850 - 1012 = 838 kg

⇒ Average weight of the boys = 838 / 15 = 55.87 kg

**∴ The average weight of the boys in that class is 55.87 kg.**
